preconditions.description: The number of words n is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) and len(word) >= 1 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word is a non-empty string consisting only of lowercase English letters.
The sum of lengths of all words does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the count modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: output_int == (sum(1 for choices in product(*[[(i, j) for j in range(len(words[i]) + 1)] for i in range(n)]) if all((words[i][0:j] + words[i][j+1:]) <= (words[i+1][0:choices[i+1][1]] + words[i+1][choices[i+1][1]+1:]) for i in range(n-1))) % 1000000007 if any(all((words[i][0:j] + words[i][j+1:]) <= (words[i+1][0:k] + words[i+1][k+1:]) for i in range(n-1)) for j in range(len(words[i]) + 1) for k in range(len(words[i+1]) + 1)) else 0)
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of valid sequences of deletions (one character from each word) such that the resulting sequence of words is lexicographically non-decreasing, modulo 10^9+7. If no such sequence exists, the output is 0.
